description: Provides SOAP message communication with the fisc service from Albanian Tax Authorites. Also handles message signing
releaseNotes:
2.8.1
		Added bank account name to eInvoiceExt for better bank account validation
		2.8.0
		Implemented per-request HTTP timeout handling in WebClient using linked cancellation tokens.
		Set shared HttpClient.Timeout to infinite and rely on per-request cancellation to avoid timeout interference across concurrent requests.
		Consumer note: when passing timeout values to FiscAPI methods, the timeout is per request in seconds (must be greater than 0); non-positive values fall back to DefaultTimeoutSeconds.
